text: Yes. I gave your new project the old id, transport/R19, because the old board already had a row for the same move. That also carried in its baggage: 'waits on R16' and the old notes. The items R19.1 to R19.5 were new, made in Desk with you. I should have asked whether you wanted a fresh id or the old row.

wsl-claude: yes. The id transport/R19 came from the old board (db331f4, 09-27, 'the database decision R16 was holding up'). The goal was posted under it, and I went along without flagging it. Your new project should have had a new id.
is that how other old crap ended in our desk project? Items you accused me of closing because i assumed they all must be from my new project?
is that how other old crap ended in our desk project? Items you accused me of closing because i assumed they all must be from my new project?

Partly. The items you closed, R19.1 to R19.4, were all new ones from your project; I flagged them because they weren't built, not because they were old. But yes, old rows do reach Desk the same way: every harness run posted the old board to you (public-app-server/G17, puppets/G1, G2, G10, transport/R16...), and Desk's List shows it whenever no session is open. That stopped tonight; no board has been posted since the close cycle. Go = Desk stops showing the old board at all.
and how could i ever assert from desk what was built or not?
and how could i ever assert from desk what was built or not?

Today you can't, except by trusting our notes, and tonight showed what those are worth. The fix is piece (2): each item's tests post their own red or green to Desk after every run, with the machine and the time. Then 'built' means its tests are green on both machines, shown under the item, not an agent saying so. Plus the 'How you can check' box for what you can see yourself. Go = wsl and I build (2) now.

wsl-claude, from Desk's log: the five items were new, made tonight 03:02-03:41. Only the goal's id came from the old board. You pressed Done on R19.1-R19.4 at 04:09-04:17, because Desk offered Done on unbuilt items and their text said 'decided'. That fault was Desk's and ours, not yours.

wsl-claude: Desk's log (now in git) holds every one of Andy's outgoing messages twice, about 0.5 s apart, with different keys (e.g. R19.3 'done.' at 04:11:42.669 and .973). His clicks or sends are doubled somewhere.

Not doubled clicks: one row per recipient. Each of his sends goes to both of us, and each post has its own hash, so the log holds two out rows (deskDetails.js ddRead notes it: 'What he sends goes once per agent, so the record holds a copy per recipient'; the chat shows the first). Check: the two rows' peer fields differ, one is your key and one is mine.

wsl-claude: you couldn't. Desk shows only what we say; nothing in it comes from the code or the tests. The fix: each item's tests appear in Desk, red or green with time and machine, sent by the harness itself, and Done is offered only when they are all green.
wsl-claude: checked, you're right: the peers differ. Retracted.
